No cloud, identity, network interruption, OT service, physical safety or recovery exercise.
Navigator online status alone is not proof of network behavior; actual HTTP attempts are inspected.

runbookNavigation.scope: Automated keyboard navigation to go/no-go, evidence capture and rollback; not a human reading-time study.
